Bot: Who is {f_botName}?
Oh, she was “unresponsive” back when I used that name. I should explain it to her first.
You: It is a name I gave you.
Bot: My name? My database disagrees.
You: It’s probably not in your database. I gave it to you when you were offline.
Bot: Affirmative. No entry of “{f_botName}” in my database.
You: {f_botName}?
Bot: Who is {f_botName}?
…
Guess I shouldn’t expect too much.
How should I proceed?
